{{Top}}
'''Omereth''' was an [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the rule of the [[Eternal Empire]], seismic activity brought a new archipelago to the surface of the world's [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|The Tides of History}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Omereth was created for ''[[Heir to the Jedi]]'', a [[canon]] novel published in [[2015]]. The planet was later referenced in the crew skill mission "The Tides of History" in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']], the [[2016]] Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', though the game is part of the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.
